# Deal Pipelines

Manage deal pipelines in Teamleader Focus.

```php
Teamleader::dealPipelines()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Deals\Pipelines` |
| Create / update / delete | ✓ / ✓ / ✓ |
| Pagination | `page_size` / `page_number`; the response includes `meta` with totals. Every page: [`lazy()` / `cursor()`](../../guides/pagination.md#fetching-everything) |

## Endpoints

- `dealPipelines.create`
- `dealPipelines.delete`
- `dealPipelines.duplicate`
- `dealPipelines.list`
- `dealPipelines.markAsDefault`
- `dealPipelines.update`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `ids` | Array of deal pipeline UUIDs to filter by |
| `status` | Filter by pipeline status (open, pending_deletion) — a string is wrapped into an array |
| `term` | Search the pipeline name |

## Accepted values

Public constants on the class. Body fields and enum values outside these lists
throw before the request is sent.

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| `STATUSES` | `open`, `pending_deletion` |

### `delete()`

```php
delete($id, ...$additionalParams): array
```

Delete a deal pipeline, optionally migrating its phases

Deals in the deleted pipeline's phases are moved to the phases named in
$migratePhases, each entry being
['old_phase_id' => ..., 'new_phase_id' => ...].

- `$id` — Pipeline UUID to delete
- `$additionalParams` — Expects an array of phase migrations as the first param

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When the migration argument is not an array
